recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中骨小樑明顯增厚、互相連結成網（骨硬化），小樑間髓腔幾乎沒有造血細胞，只剩淡粉紅色纖維化基質與散在脂肪，符合纖維化期原發性骨髓纖維化的「燃盡」骨髓。
features: Markedly thickened, irregular and anastomosing bony trabeculae occupying much of the core (osteosclerosis)
Intertrabecular spaces replaced by pale, loose-to-fibrillary eosinophilic fibrotic stroma with dilated sinusoids
Scattered fat vacuoles; overall cellularity very low with only rare residual hematopoietic cells
No discernible megakaryocyte clusters or blasts at this magnification
Low-power view only; fibrosis grade requires reticulin/trichrome stains
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows marked osteosclerosis with broad, irregular, interconnecting trabeculae. The intertrabecular marrow is severely hypocellular (<5%) and replaced by pale fibrotic stroma with scattered adipocytes, sinusoidal ectasia and only minimal residual hematopoiesis. No atypical megakaryocyte clusters or blast aggregates are appreciated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with advanced (fibrotic stage) myelofibrosis with osteosclerosis; reticulin and trichrome stains are recommended for grading.

ddx.dx: Post-polycythemia vera or post-essential thrombocythemia myelofibrosis
ddx.vs: Morphologically indistinguishable burnt-out marrow; separation depends on the documented prior MPN history.
Hypocellular marrow is fatty with normal-thickness trabeculae and no stromal fibrosis or osteosclerosis.
Shows cohesive epithelial tumor nests (keratin-positive) within the fibrosis, which are not seen here.
Features peritrabecular fibrosis with active osteoclastic resorption (dissecting osteitis) while intertrabecular hematopoiesis is preserved.
